title: test(cli): the last five tsx-launched source-CLI spawners run bin/run-dev.js under node
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XP9bgrJ5m1yr71Fea5fTLNk)_

Part of #23181 (slice 36). The card stays open for later slices. This slice takes one family, the last five `packages/cli` test files that spawned the source CLI through the tsx launcher, and one lever, (a) tsx to `process.execPath`.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`packages/cli` 里最后 5 个经 `node_modules/.bin/tsx` 起 CLI 源码入口 `bin/run-dev.js` 的测试文件，改为用 `process.execPath`（测试自己的 node）起同一个入口，与 slice 25/29/34/35 的写法一致。
- **为什么改**：卡 #23181 的测试提速职责。这 5 个文件在定时 CI 里都超过 10 秒（合计 103.0 秒）。tsx 包装层只是在 CLI 前面多起一个 node 进程；入口、`src/`、`NODE_ENV=development` 两种起法完全一样。本机 A/B 每个文件快 21%–30%。
- **风险与回滚**：只改测试文件，不发布任何东西（cli 的 `files[]` 只有 dist、README、CHANGELOG）；参数、cwd、env、stdio、超时、断言、用例数、层级、`// test-budget:` 头都没动；回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/test/i18n-extract-check-json.test.ts`（`spawnSync` 带 180 秒超时的那处）；`packages/cli/test/generate-stack-reach.test.ts`（在一个 beforeAll 里顺序起 10 次 CLI 的那个文件）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration test/dependency-range-doors.test.ts` → 5/5 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Measure first.** The order's step 1 read the newest completed scheduled `ci.yml` run on `main`, **41304707231** (head `dd6349ecfa`, 2026-11-01T12:04Z). No schedule run whose head contains slice 35 (`2678600d57`) had completed yet: the cron is `0 */4 * * *`, and `2678600d57` landed after `dd6349ecfa`. So every `runServe()` caller was marked "re-measure after slice 35" and was not eligible. All 8 Test Core shard logs were fetched whole (exit 0 each, 3.5 to 12.0 MB) and parsed with slice 23's parser: 6,232 vitest file lines, **110 files over 10 s**, 91 of them in `domain:server` packages. The table and grouping are in `pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s36/offenders.md`.

**The family, picked by rule.** Of the cause groups, only one fits a lever this card has already proven and is not blocked by the order:

| group | files | summed wall (s) | over 10 s (s) | verdict |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| spawns `bin/run-dev.js` through `node_modules/.bin/tsx` | 5 | 103.0 | 53.0 | **lever (a) fits, picked** |
| calls `runServe()` | 5 | 140.8 | 90.8 | not eligible: already moved off tsx by slice 35, re-measure |
| tsx-binary child is a `.ts`/`.mts` helper, not `bin/run-dev.js` (`emit-json-pipe`, `serve-runtime-state-project-key`) | 2 | 23.0 | 3.0 | no proven lever (slice 25: a `.ts` helper child gains nothing off the launcher) |
| already spawning under `process.execPath` or the built entry | 63 | 2593.4 | 1963.4 | no (a); headers declare distinct (command, flags, fixture) triples, so no (c) candidate |
| other cli in-process / non-cli server in-process / not `domain:server` | 35 | — | — | no (a)/(b)/(c) fit |

Runner-up: no second family is eligible under (a), (b) or (c). The next group by wall is the `runServe()` callers, and they need a re-measure, not a lever.

No open PR touches the five files, and none of them is a `runServe()` caller or a test file of seat 1's #28412, #28657 or #28564 card threads.

**The switch.** In each of the five files, the spawn passes `process.execPath` where it passed `TSX`, with `bin/run-dev.js` still the first argument; the local `const TSX = resolve(…, 'node_modules/.bin/tsx')` goes, and `CLI` gains the same docblock slice 34 put on it. argv, cwd, env (`childEnv(…)`), stdio, `maxBuffer`, timeouts, matching and every assertion are unchanged.

| file | CI wall (run 41304707231) | spawn |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `test/generate-stack-reach.test.ts` | 30.8 s (shard 6) | `execFile`, ten sequential runs in one `beforeAll` |
| `test/i18n-extract-check-json.test.ts` | 22.4 s (shard 4) | `spawnSync`, `timeout: 180_000` |
| `test/i18n-extract-check-dry-run.test.ts` | 19.3 s (shard 6) | `spawnSync`, `timeout: 180_000` |
| `test/dependency-range-doors.test.ts` | 17.6 s (shard 1) | `execFile` |
| `test/lint-eval-generator-refusal-separator.test.ts` | 12.8 s (shard 1) | `execFile`, four runs in one `beforeAll` |

**Why the child is the same.** `bin/run-dev.js` pins `NODE_ENV=development`, and under it @oclif/core registers tsx in-process and maps `dist/commands` to `src/commands` (slice 34's `DEBUG='*ts-path*'` probe, `pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s34/oclif-ts-path-probe.txt`). The launcher only adds a second node process in front.

**No SIGTERM→SIGKILL settle here.** Slice 35's settle is for a long-lived child that a test kills and moves past. All five spawns are one-shot commands that run to exit and are awaited; none is killed by the test. The two `spawnSync` timeouts are a failure path only and stay as they are.

Not changed: no case name, case count, timeout, tier, project or `// test-budget:` header; no file under `test/helpers/**`; no source file. Comments that stay true (oclif still runs `src/` through tsx in-process) are left alone.

## Tests

- **All five files pass on head `83fbe94b`**: every A/B head leg below is exit 0 with the same test count as base (8, 5, 5, 5, 5).
- **A/B**, head `83fbe94b` vs base `2678600d57`, one box (4 cores), one lock hold, N=3, `vitest run --project integration FILE`. Base bytes are swapped into the same path, so both legs keep the same tier and config. Each leg is its own vitest invocation, and the order alternates per round. Afterwards HEAD bytes were restored and proven by blob hash, and `git diff HEAD` was empty. Reading: the default reporter's per-file line. Every leg exit 0.

  | file | tests | base file line (s) | head file line (s) | change |
  |:--|--:|:--|:--|--:|
  | `generate-stack-reach` | 8 | 23.59, 22.87, 25.02 | 17.47, 17.28, 17.90 | -26.3% (mean 23.83 → 17.55) |
  | `i18n-extract-check-json` | 5 | 17.20, 16.36, 17.69 | 13.79, 13.00, 13.57 | -21.3% (mean 17.08 → 13.45) |
  | `i18n-extract-check-dry-run` | 5 | 14.97, 14.36, 15.57 | 11.54, 11.09, 12.73 | -21.3% (mean 14.97 → 11.79) |
  | `dependency-range-doors` | 5 | 21.03, 20.23, 23.04 | 15.06, 14.61, 15.68 | -29.5% (mean 21.43 → 15.12) |
  | `lint-eval-generator-refusal-separator` | 5 | 16.04, 15.48, 17.22 | 11.60, 11.50, 12.20 | -27.6% (mean 16.25 → 11.77) |

  Raw legs and the script: `pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s36/ab-rows.txt`, `ab-summary.txt`, `ab.sh`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck` over `tsconfig.test.json`): lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the five files: exit 0 (`@objectstack/cli` has no `lint` script).
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed (test-only).

## Acceptance notes

- **`skip-changeset`.** Test-only. `@objectstack/cli`'s `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and its build emits no `*.test.ts` into `dist/`. No package's `files[]` ships a changed file.
- **Left for the card.** `test/validate-override-declarations.test.ts` spawns `bin/run-dev.js` through the same launcher, but it read under 10 s in run 41304707231, so it is not in this family. `emit-json-pipe` and `serve-runtime-state-project-key` keep tsx: their children are `.mts`/`.ts` helpers, not the CLI entry. Carrier: #23181.

## Verification

All local readings are on head `83fbe94b`.

- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the real diff: 48 commands. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe. 47 exit 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads every package's built `dist/`, and this worktree built only the `@objectstack/cli` closure, so it is **NOT MEASURED** locally and CI's Lint run is its reading. `--ran` reconciliation: `48 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 47 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`. Record: `pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s36/gates-ran-83fbe94b.txt`.
- By hand: `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range 2678600d57..HEAD` exit 0.
- `test:repo` is not run locally: the diff touches no `repo`-project test and the derivation names none. CI's Test Core is its reading.
- CI: the PR's check-runs are the seat's reading.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint over the touched files)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
